classification.difficultyReason: Calculate cylinder capacity and reverse the volume formula to find water depth, converting units and rounding.

content.prompt: A cylindrical water tank stands on its circular base. It has a diameter of $2\text{ m}$ and a height of $1.5\text{ m}$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the volume of the tank, to the nearest litre.

answer.worked:
The radius is $2\div2=1\text{ m}$.

$$\begin{align*}V&=\pi r^2h\\V&=\pi\times1^2\times1.5\\V&=1.5\pi\text{ m}^3\\V&=1500\pi\text{ L}\\V&\approx4712\text{ L}\quad\text{(nearest litre)}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the depth of water in the tank, to the nearest centimetre, when it contains $2000$ litres of water.

answer.worked:
$2000\text{ L}=2\text{ m}^3$ and $r=1\text{ m}$.

$$\begin{align*}V&=\pi r^2h\\2&=\pi\times1^2\times h\\h&=\frac{2}{\pi}\text{ m}\\h&=\frac{200}{\pi}\text{ cm}\\h&\approx64\text{ cm}\quad\text{(nearest centimetre)}\end{align*}$$
